items.title: [Epic] Redraw all 9 VOID speaker SVGs — replace VTracer auto-traces with hand-crafted technical drawings
items.body:
All VOID speaker SVGs in `05-speaker-assets/svg/` were generated by VTracer 0.6.12 bitmap auto-trace. They are black outline blobs with no dimension annotations, no labels, and no styling — not usable as technical documentation.

**Problem:** VTracer captures shape outlines only. It cannot recover dimension text, annotation leaders, or engineering drawing structure from a PNG technical drawing.

**Source PNGs:** `05-speaker-assets/png/void-*-front.png`, `*-side.png`, `*-top.png`
**Style reference:** `07-tech-pack/rack-elevation.svg` (dark bg `#0d1117`, hand-crafted geometry, `<text>` dimension labels)
**Methodology:** Vision analysis of source PNG → hand-craft SVG geometry → `<text>` dimension annotations → dark theme → SVGO optimize → ImageMagick compare validation

## Subtasks
- [ ] Research & establish PNG→SVG validation pipeline
- [ ] void-air-motion-v2-front.svg (side + top-down views, 658×854mm)
- [ ] void-air-motion-v2-side.svg (horn profile, 658mm depth)
- [ ] void-air-motion-v2-top.svg (3D perspective + flat plan)
- [ ] void-air-vantage-front.svg (front face, 719mm wide)
- [ ] void-air-vantage-side.svg
- [ ] void-air-vantage-top.svg
- [ ] void-venu-215-v2-front.svg (enclosure front, 860×446mm)
- [ ] void-venu-215-v2-side.svg (636×454mm)
- [ ] void-venu-215-v2-top.svg

items.title: Research & establish PNG→SVG validation pipeline for speaker technical drawings
items.body:
Before redrawing all 9 speaker SVGs, establish a repeatable validation methodology so each redrawn SVG can be verified against its source PNG.

**Deliverables:**
1. ImageMagick `compare` command that diffs rendered SVG against source PNG (pixel-level)
2. Decision matrix: when to use `<path>` vs `<rect>`/`<circle>` for speaker geometry
3. Dimension extraction method: Claude vision reads PNG → values go into `<text>` elements
4. SVGO config that preserves `<title>`, `<desc>`, `<text>` while stripping VTracer cruft
5. One-paragraph methodology doc committed to `06-reference-docs/svg-drawing-methodology.md`

**Reference document:** Research on PNG→SVG conversion workflow (OCR, layout analysis, visual diff, accessibility structure per SVG 2.0 spec)

**Tools to evaluate for future automation:**
- Inkscape CLI (`inkscape --export-plain-svg`) — potential MCP wrapper
- Potrace via ImageMagick pipeline for clean geometric shapes
- SVGO Node.js CLI (already in `package.json` ecosystem)

items.title: Redraw void-air-motion-v2-front.svg from source PNG
items.body:
**Source:** `05-speaker-assets/png/void-air-motion-v2-front.png`
**Current SVG:** `05-speaker-assets/svg/void-air-motion-v2-front.svg` — VTracer blob, 86 lines, no dimensions

**PNG contains two views:**
- Upper: side cross-section of horn + mid driver (height 658mm / 26.5", depth 361.5mm / 14.2")
- Lower: top-down plan showing two large circular drivers + horn (854mm / 33.6" wide, 672mm / 26.5" deep)

**Requirements:**
- Dark background `#0d1117`
- White/gray strokes for geometry, `#fcd34d` for dimension annotations
- Actual `<text>` elements for all dimension labels (not traced)
- `<title>` and `<desc>` for accessibility
- Labeled `<g>` groups per view
- SVGO optimized after drawing
- ImageMagick compare diff saved to `05-speaker-assets/svg/validation/`

**Style reference:** `07-tech-pack/rack-elevation.svg`
